name: Silicone Oil Brush
subtitle: Food-grade brush for cooking and baking
description: This silicone oil brush is a reusable kitchen tool for applying oil, butter, marinades, and sauces during cooking, baking, grilling, and pastry preparation. It features food-grade silicone bristles, a BPA-free plastic handle, and heat resistance rated up to 230°C.
story: Use this brush when spreading oil across cookware, basting food on the grill, coating pastries, or applying sauces during preparation. The flexible silicone bristles are designed to distribute liquids evenly and resist shedding, while the handle provides a comfortable grip. Its heat-resistant construction supports use around hot cookware within the listed temperature range. After use, the dishwasher-safe design simplifies cleaning, making it practical for repeated cooking, baking, BBQ, and grilling tasks.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
